methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
REGENT Craft is a Series A-stage transportation company that has raised $60M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private frontier-tech transportation firms, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero; no direct public comparables exist in this subsector.

Stage-progression analysis is applicable and forms the primary valuation method. Using total raised ($60M) as a base proxy and applying a typical Series A-to-subsequent-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $120M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow transportation frontier-tech cohort—only 3 same-sector peers exist in the broader dataset, but none satisfied minimum clustering thresholds (n≥3) at matched stage or valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M (low) to $138M (high), with a median point of $120M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around true market comparables; the absence of tight peer multiples at identical stage and scale means the step-up multiplier itself should be stress-tested against founder experience, market timing, and capital efficiency metrics not present in this dataset. Further narrowing would require either expanded Transportation comps or granular operational benchmarks.
